overview.short: Dudhsagar Falls is an iconic four-tiered waterfall on the Mandovi River, famous for its milky cascade and rainforest trek.
overview.description: Dudhsagar Falls (lit. 'Sea of Milk') is a four-tiered waterfall on the Mahadayi River in the Indian state of Goa. It is 60km from Panaji by road and is located on the Belagavi–Vasco Da Gama rail route about 46km east of Madgaon and 80km south of Belagavi . Dudhsagar Falls is perched at the top of a crescent shaped valley and surrounded by pristine forests, and it is amongst India's tallest waterfalls with a height of 310 m (1017 feet) and an average width of 30 metres (100 feet).

topPlaces.description: Bhagwan Mahaveer Sanctuary and Mollem National Park is a 240 square kilometres (93 sq mi) protected area located in the Western Ghats of West India, in Dharbandora taluk, Goa State, along the eastern border with Karnataka. faq.q: What is the best time to visit Dudhsagar Falls?

faq.a: The nearest airport is Dudhsagar Falls / nearest airport (30 km) and the nearest railway station is Madgaon Junction (Goa) (38 km). Roads are generally good; check seasonal/monsoon conditions before high-altitude or remote stretches.
